NDT software in Edmonton: built for turnarounds, fab shops and the road north

Edmonton's inspection market is physical in a way Calgary's is not. Northeast of the city, Alberta's Industrial Heartland packs refineries, upgraders and petrochemical plants into a short drive: Imperial's Strathcona refinery, Suncor's Edmonton refinery, Shell's Scotford upgrader and refinery complex, the Sturgeon Refinery and the chemical plants around Fort Saskatchewan. South of the city, Nisku and Leduc are full of pressure vessel shops, pipe spool fabricators and module yards building equipment for the oil sands. And Edmonton is the staging point for almost every crew heading up Highway 63 to Fort McMurray.

An Edmonton NDT company therefore lives on three calendars at once: the spring and fall turnaround season, steady shop inspection work, and rotational crews in the north. The Atlantis ERP solution gives that company one system configured for NDT and inspection work: technician certifications, procedures, instruments and calibration, crew dispatch, NDT reports, quotes, timesheets and invoicing, all tied to the same job. It is affordable, accessible from the shop floor or a plant trailer, and fully customized to your company. Demo and quote on request.

ERP for NDT companies in Edmonton: the apps and where they fit

An ERP for NDT companies in Edmonton has to cope with sudden headcount swings, weld-by-weld shop records and plant clients with strict document requirements. The Atlantis ERP handles those in NDT-specific apps that share one database, so a technician's certificate, the instrument in their hands and the report they sign all connect.

  • Team Assignments for turnaround and shop dispatch with availability and blocked double-booking.
  • Certificates for certifications, vision tests and company accreditations.
  • NDT Reports for 17 method-specific report types, weld lines and WPS references.
  • Procedures for a controlled register with locked approved revisions.
  • Asset Management for instruments, sources-related items, consumables and calibration.
  • Quotations, Timesheets, Expenses and Invoicing for the money side.

Project, CRM, Purchase, Fleet, Employees and Dashboards complete the picture. Here is how each one maps to Edmonton work.

Crew dispatch and scheduling software for Industrial Heartland turnarounds

Crew dispatch and scheduling software gets its real test during a turnaround, when an Edmonton contractor may need to double its field headcount for a few weeks and every technician is being pulled between three plants. The Atlantis ERP handles this in Team Assignments, where each job moves through planned, dispatched, in field, submitted and closed.

The technician availability calendar holds assigned, leave, training, sick and unavailable entries, and overlaps are blocked. When a Level II radiographer is booked to a Scotford unit for night shift, the system will not let another coordinator put the same person on a Nisku shop job that week. Equipment serial numbers follow the same rule, so the one IRIS unit or the one TOFD scanner cannot be promised to two plants at once, and the dispatcher is warned if an assigned instrument is out of calibration.

Each assignment carries site GPS coordinates and mobilisation and demobilisation dates, which is useful when the gate a crew must report to is not the plant's mailing address. Technician status, current assignment, utilisation percentage and next available date show in calendar, kanban and list views, so the operations manager can see during planning whether the company can actually staff the scope before committing to it. The Project app holds the client PO, contract, methods, codes, scope, acceptance criteria, safety induction and work permit fields, which is where plant orientation records for each technician belong.

Technician certification tracking software when headcount doubles

Technician certification tracking software matters most when you are onboarding people quickly for a turnaround and a plant's contractor coordinator wants every certificate before site access. In the Atlantis ERP each certification record holds scheme, level, method, certifying body, issue, expiry and renewal dates, industry sector, OJT and training hours, exam result and attachments, and the status is computed as active, expiring soon, expired or revoked.

Edmonton technicians typically carry ISO 9712 certificates through the Canadian national program run by the Canadian General Standards Board (formerly NRCan). Surge hires from other provinces or from the US may add SNT-TC-1A employer certifications, CP-189, PCN or CSWIP, and all of them sit in one register. The employee NDT profile adds technician flag, highest level, methods certified, radiation safety training, radiation badge number and medical fitness expiry, which is the set of documents a radiography crew needs before shooting in a plant.

Vision tests are recorded with Jaeger near vision, far vision, colour perception, contrast, examiner and clinic. The ERP creates warning tasks 90 days before a certificate or vision test expires and sends configurable email alerts with your chosen recipients, look-ahead days and resend interval. Examination sheets hold general, specific and practical scores against a passing score. Timesheets warn when a technician without a valid certificate logs hours, which catches the problem before it reaches the client. Atlantis offers ASNT SNT-TC-1A-based training through eLearning; ISO 9712 and other schemes are recorded, not trained.

NDT reporting software for Nisku and Leduc fabrication shops

NDT reporting software for a fabrication shop has to keep up with weld counts. A pipe spool order or a pressure vessel for an oil sands module can generate hundreds of weld inspections, each needing a traceable result. The Atlantis ERP includes 17 report types: UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, ECT, IRIS, PAUT, MFL, TOFD, PWHT, PMI, hardness, UT thickness, ferrite, holiday/coating and computed radiography, each with its own numbering sequence.

Weld and job lines record each joint with defect type and orientation, and the report captures work order, request, WPS, contract, drawing, procedure and standard references. RT reports record source, technique, IQI type and placement; UT reports carry a probe calibration table; PAUT and TOFD suit the fabricators replacing film with volumetric UT; PWHT, PMI, hardness and ferrite cover the stainless and alloy work common in upgrader and refinery piping. Every report ends with acceptable, not acceptable or acceptable with remarks.

The review workflow runs draft, in progress, review, approved and sent, with inspector, reviewer and approver signatures and a field for an authorized inspector's name and signature where the job requires one. Reports come out on your own versioned templates in Excel, Word, PDF or HTML, and Excel templates are filled automatically from mapped cells so a fabricator's weld map spreadsheet does not need retyping. The offline field app lets a technician capture photos and sign on screen inside a shop bay or plant unit where signal is poor. See also Digital Twin Reporting Software.

Procedures and ABSA-facing documentation

ABSA, Alberta's pressure equipment safety authority, is headquartered in Edmonton, and a large share of the fabricators and repair organizations it oversees are in the Edmonton region. When a shop's quality program calls for NDT to a specific procedure, the NDT subcontractor's procedure register becomes part of the audit trail. The Atlantis ERP does not interpret code requirements for you, but it keeps your controlled documents in a state you can show.

The Procedures app records document number, revision, method, scope, material, applicable standard such as ASME Section V, acceptance criteria and the body text or uploaded file. Procedures move through draft, submitted, reviewed, approved and published, plus rejected and archived, with prepared, reviewed and approved by names and dates. Approved revisions are locked and each revision keeps a snapshot, so you can show which revision a report was issued against. Approvers get notifications and reminders.

For new techniques, an AI-assisted first draft saves the Level III from starting with a blank page, and falls back to a built-in template; the Level III still reviews and approves. NCR and CAPA workflows are configured during implementation for shops that want nonconformances tracked in the same place, and company certifications such as ISO 9001 carry alert days.

Calibration management software across shop, plant and camp

Calibration management software for an Edmonton company has to follow instruments that move between a Nisku shop, a Heartland turnaround and a northern camp within one season. The Atlantis ERP tracks each instrument, probe and source-related item by serial number with type, assigned person, condition, asset tag, firmware, accessories and lifecycle status (new, active, in calibration, in repair, rented out, retired, disposed). Rental rates can be recorded for gear you rent out to other contractors in peak season.

Calibration records hold provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, accredited-lab flag, result and next due date, and the certificate register tracks valid, expiring and expired status with the lab accreditation number and PDF. Reservations prevent clashes when two turnaround scopes want the same unit, and inbound and outbound movements are logged. Issue and return needs supervisor and manager approval with condition recorded at both ends.

The maintenance log records preventive, corrective, repair, cleaning, firmware updates and probe replacement. Consumables such as film-related chemicals, MT particles, penetrant, developer and couplant carry reorder levels and low-stock flags, which matters when a turnaround burns through a month of stock in a week. Purchase records calibration labs and OEM dealers as vendor types, with accreditation details.

Fleet and radioactive source transport for Edmonton radiography crews

Many Edmonton contractors run radiography crews, and those crews depend on vehicles that are fit to carry exposure devices. The Fleet app records vehicle purpose, whether the vehicle can carry radioactive sources, the transport licence number and expiry, and the assignment of each vehicle to a project and driver with dates and mileage.

That means the dispatcher can check, in the same system, that the truck, the source-rated driver's radiation training and the crew's certificates are all current before a night shift starts at a Heartland unit. Transport and nuclear substance licensing rules are set by federal regulators, and the ERP records the licence data you already hold rather than replacing your radiation safety program. The Maintenance app handles preventive and corrective requests on vehicles as well as instruments.

NDT quoting and invoicing software for turnaround and shop billing

NDT quoting and invoicing software for Edmonton has to handle two very different billing patterns: long turnaround jobs with day, night and standby rates, and shop work billed per weld, per film or per day. Quotations carry job type, site, project dates and applicable codes, with NDT service products flagged by method and category, a global discount and a branded PDF; clients can accept and sign online, and the quote converts to a sales order.

Timesheets record inspection, travel, standby and setup time with method, site, client, equipment serial, billable flag and rate multiplier, so night-shift and overtime premiums are applied from the timesheet rather than from memory. Timesheets go through approval before billing, and Expenses capture hotel, per diem and mileage costs to re-bill.

Invoices carry NDT project, job or PO number, site, invoice type and industry sector, with subtotals for labour, equipment and consumables, and lines showing cost centre, method, equipment serial, technician, rate type and days or hours. Setting up one cost centre per turnaround makes margin per event visible on the financial dashboard, which shows revenue, cost of sales, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA and outstanding invoices across twelve months. GST and payment terms are configured during implementation.

Inspection management software in Edmonton: dashboards, CRM and integrations

Inspection management software should show the owner the risks before a client finds them. Edmonton dashboards typically watch certificates expiring or expired, calibration due and overdue, and issued equipment overdue for return, which after a turnaround is often the biggest leak. The Dashboards app gives those NDT KPIs in spreadsheet-style views.

The open REST API integrates with SAP, Maximo, NetSuite, QuickBooks or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation, which suits contractors whose plant clients issue work through large maintenance systems. CRM records service line, NDT service type, industry sector and estimated technicians and days per lead, scores leads from 0 to 100, and supports drip sequences for EPC and fabricator prospects. Business card scanning turns cards collected at trade events into leads.

Affordable, customizable ERP for inspection companies in Edmonton: implementation

An affordable, customizable ERP for inspection companies in Edmonton is set up around your turnaround calendar, your shop clients and your northern rotations. Atlantis NDT configures and supports each system, and pricing is quote on request.

  1. Map the work. Turnaround, shop and rotational job types, rate types and cost centres.
  2. Load the records. Certificates, vision tests, instruments, calibration history, vehicles and procedures from your current files.
  3. Build templates. Weld reports, RT reports and invoice layouts that match what your clients already accept.
  4. Set alerts and approvals. Who hears about expiring certificates and calibration, and who approves procedures and timesheets.
  5. Go live before peak season. Ideally ahead of a spring or fall turnaround so the surge runs on the new system.

Founder Anoop Rayavarapu is an ASNT NDT Level III, so setup conversations stay in NDT language. Book an Edmonton NDT ERP demo.

Best NDT software for small NDT companies in Edmonton

For a small Edmonton shop, the best NDT software is the one that removes admin without adding it. Many small companies start with Certificates, Asset Management, NDT Reports and Invoicing, then add Team Assignments once they take on turnaround work. Because each system is configured, you only set up what you use. Request a quote for a small Edmonton NDT company or ask about turnaround dispatch.

Frequently asked questions

What is the best ERP for NDT companies in Edmonton?

The best fit is an ERP built around NDT records: certifications, calibration, dispatch and method-specific reports. The Atlantis ERP is configured for NDT companies and priced on a quote-on-request basis.

Can the ERP stop the same technician being booked to two plants?

Yes. Overlapping availability entries are blocked, so a technician or an equipment serial number cannot be double-booked.

Does it handle weld-by-weld reports for fabrication shops?

Yes. Reports include weld and job lines with defect type and orientation, plus WPS, drawing, procedure and standard references.

Can we record which trucks can carry radioactive sources?

Yes. Fleet records whether a vehicle can carry radioactive sources, its transport licence number and expiry, and its assignment to project and driver.

Do you train technicians to ISO 9712?

No. Atlantis training is ASNT SNT-TC-1A-based only. The ERP records ISO 9712 certificates from the Canadian program alongside other schemes.

How long does implementation take?

It depends on the apps, templates and integrations in scope. The plan and quote are agreed after discovery, and many Edmonton companies aim to go live before turnaround season.
